svg.aria-label: Riemann construction and ATM replicating put payoff for KXBTCD-26AUG0421
svg.text: the ATM put as an integral of 17 digitals, and as the stack of digital puts that replicates it · expiry 2026-08-05 01:00 UTC
F(K) = Q(S <= K) · area left of the strike = the put
payoff at expiry vs settlement price
every quoted strike in the 2%-98% CDF band
left: the shaded area is P(K_atm) = int_0^K F(u) du, ruled at every strike into the dK columns it is
summed from. The staircase above the curve is the right-hand sum (put_hi), the one below it the
right: dK digital puts struck at each K_i+1 super-replicate the put; the same widths struck one strike
down sub-replicate it. The gap between them is the grid. Each slab is one digital's dK, and they stack
below 63,500 the ladder stops: both stacks go flat at 800, the payoff does not. That wedge is the tail
greeks: dP/dK is exact -- it is the complementary digital Q(S <= K) at K, the left panel's own curve,
priced by this ladder. delta, gamma, vega and theta differentiate in F, sigma and t, which one expiry
cannot pin down, so they are Black-76 at this strike's own IV
warning: dropped 144 of 161 threshold strikes pinned at the extreme tick; integrating their midpoints
would have added ~$86 to every call. The region beyond the live quotes is the tail model's job now
warning: digital curve was not monotone; PAVA-repaired before integrating
warning: 14.5% of probability mass sits outside the quoted strikes; forward and wing calls lean on the
warning: the call column implies 35% vol at the money but the density implies 25% (1.4x); value is
